name: Ramp
bestFor: AI-automated corporate card, spend, and accounts-payable management with a genuinely free core plan
description: A finance operations platform (corporate cards, expense management, AP/invoice OCR) with Ramp Intelligence: a natural-language finance assistant, AI policy generation, and agentic approval of routine transactions.

freeTier.limits: Free plan: unlimited corporate cards, expense management, AP with invoice OCR, basic accounting automation

paidTier.notes: Ramp Plus is $15/user/month plus a platform fee based on team size (20% off with annual billing), adding AI expense reviews, auto-coded bills, multi-entity support, and NetSuite/Sage Intacct integrations. Ramp Enterprise is custom-priced with dedicated support and implementation services.

name: Vic.ai
bestFor: Autonomous, high-volume invoice processing for finance teams that want AP off their plate
description: An AI-first accounts payable platform that autonomously processes, codes, and approves invoices at high confidence thresholds, reducing manual AP data entry.

freeTier.limits: No free tier or self-serve trial; enterprise-only annual contracts

paidTier.notes: No public price list; priced by user count, monthly invoice volume, and module mix (Autopilot, VicAnalytics, VicCard, VicPay). Reported deal sizes run from roughly $25,000 to several hundred thousand dollars per year.

name: Brex
bestFor: AI-powered corporate cards and spend management with a genuinely free Essentials tier
description: A corporate card and spend management platform whose AI features — compliance audit detection, an expense assistant that auto-fills reports, and anomaly alerts — sit on top of unlimited global cards, approvals, and reimbursements. Capital One completed its acquisition of Brex in April 2026.

freeTier.limits: Essentials plan: unlimited corporate cards, expense rules, bill pay, and accounting integrations for up to two entities, no per-seat fee

paidTier.notes: Premium is $12/user/month, adding AI compliance audit detection, the Brex AI expense assistant, dynamic approval chains, and deeper ERP/HRIS integrations. Enterprise (unlimited entities, local card issuance, dedicated support) and Smart Card (procurement) are custom-quoted.

name: Puzzle
bestFor: AI-native, real-time bookkeeping for startups that replaces manual month-end close
description: An AI-native accounting platform that auto-categorizes transactions at 98%+ accuracy, keeps financials updated in real time instead of monthly, and connects natively to startup-stack tools like Stripe, Ramp, Brex, and Gusto.

freeTier.limits: Free trial available; no persistent free plan

paidTier.notes: Starter $30/mo (1 seat, 25 lifetime AI credits); Core $72/mo (5 seats); Complete $120/mo (unlimited seats, 100 AI credits/month, AI-powered reconciliations); Scale $360/mo (unlimited seats, 300 AI credits/month). Yearly billing saves 20%. Bookkeeper-assisted tiers are priced separately. US-only.
